dct_description_sm: Throughout this project (the first of four stages in a multiyear initiative), Arctic North focused on identifying the risks and opportunities of climate change impacts and on identifying priorities in adaptation community planning in the Inuvialuit Settlement Region. The project aimed to identify gaps in adaptation planning and to make recommendations to assist in future community adaptation planning in the region.

dct_title_s: Climate Change Vulnerability and Adaptation in the Inuvialuit Settlement Region: A Literature Review and Gap Analysis
